question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Actually** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Adding "**ly**" to words often transforms adjectives into adverbs. • Adverbs provide additional information about how an action is performed, the manner in which something is done, or the extent to which something happens. • "**Actually**" is an adverb that means "in fact or really". (वास्तव में) • **For example**: *She said she'd be there on time, but, actually, she arrived much later than expected.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it fits with the context of the sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Manually**" means doing something by hand or without the aid of a machine. (हाथ से या मशीन की सहायता के बिना कुछ करना) • "**Gladly**" means doing something with pleasure or willingness. (ख़ुशी या इच्छा से कुछ करना) • "**Suddenly**" means happening quickly or unexpectedly. (जल्दी या अप्रत्याशित रूप से घटित होना) 46:Tb8d, The correct answer is: **act**
